title: VK-only General Interrogation: In lib60870-C v2.4.0, parsing a crafted IEC 60870-5-104 I-frame for...
purpose: Combine the issue-supported vulnerable structure with a conservative model-prior protocol form without copying the crash payload.
expected_behavior: Parser accepts VSQ object count=0x64 (100 objects) despite short ASDU body after header; InformationObject_ParseObjectAddress called with invalid startIndex leads to out-of-bounds read in TestCommand_getFromBuffer path (crashes with heap over-read under ASAN)
constraints_preserved: 0x68 start/end octets consistent with FT1.1 framing
IOA structure omitted to force parser to read past body end
issue_safety_notes: Traces exact vulnerability trigger from GHSA-G3W7-X5RX-83XM (TypeID 104 C_TS_NA_1, VSQ exceeding ASDU body) and GHSA-7V97-JMWV-W5J7; no crash bytes copied; uses model-prior conservative form
